[[File:Levon Knowles portrait.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Levon Knowles.]]
'''Levon Knowles''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Rogue 35, from Brewster, NY. After Decipher's SWCCG run, the slot was marked Retired.<ref name="smlist" />

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).
